<SwitchPreference
        android:key="hecker_double_tap_sleep"
        android:title="@string/hecker_double_tap_title"
        android:summary="@string/hecker_double_tap_summary"
        android:defaultValue="true"
        android:persistent="true" />

    <SwitchPreference android:key="hecker_swipe_down" android:title="@string/hecker_swipe_title" android:summary="@string/hecker_swipe_summary" android:defaultValue="true" />
    <PreferenceCategory android:title="@string/hecker_glass_title">
        <ListPreference android:key="hecker_glass" android:title="@string/hecker_glass_style" android:entries="@array/hecker_glass_styles" android:entryValues="@array/hecker_glass_values" android:defaultValue="1" android:summary="%s" />
        <SwitchPreference android:key="hecker_glass_dock" android:title="@string/hecker_glass_dock" android:defaultValue="true" />
        <SwitchPreference android:key="hecker_glass_folders" android:title="@string/hecker_glass_folders" android:defaultValue="true" />
        <SwitchPreference android:key="hecker_glass_search" android:title="@string/hecker_glass_search" android:defaultValue="true" />
        <SwitchPreference android:key="hecker_glass_widgets" android:title="@string/hecker_glass_widgets" android:defaultValue="true" />
        <ListPreference android:key="hecker_glass_corner_tl" android:title="@string/hecker_glass_corner_tl" android:entries="@array/hecker_glass_corners" android:entryValues="@array/hecker_glass_corner_values" android:defaultValue="28" android:summary="%s" />
        <ListPreference android:key="hecker_glass_corner_tr" android:title="@string/hecker_glass_corner_tr" android:entries="@array/hecker_glass_corners" android:entryValues="@array/hecker_glass_corner_values" android:defaultValue="28" android:summary="%s" />
        <ListPreference android:key="hecker_glass_corner_br" android:title="@string/hecker_glass_corner_br" android:entries="@array/hecker_glass_corners" android:entryValues="@array/hecker_glass_corner_values" android:defaultValue="28" android:summary="%s" />
        <ListPreference android:key="hecker_glass_corner_bl" android:title="@string/hecker_glass_corner_bl" android:entries="@array/hecker_glass_corners" android:entryValues="@array/hecker_glass_corner_values" android:defaultValue="28" android:summary="%s" />
    </PreferenceCategory>
</androidx.preference.PreferenceScreen>
